description.value:
When Arasaka's Internal Affairs wants a traitor made into an example, it sends one of these. Pilots are picked for blade skill, chrome tolerance and the worst psych evals on file. The idea is loyalty through fear, and it works.

Cost: 26,700eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 68 (20d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: MonoVision
Chrome: Atomic Sensors, Berserk (w/ Biodyne ‘Berserker’ OS), Jump Boosters ×2, Low Light/Infrared/UV, Microrotors, Mantis Blade (w/ Spring Loaded) ×2, Nano Plating, Radar/Sonar Implant, Synaptic Accelerator

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
